<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria: breaking an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forming an amide. This avoids the bond format issue.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
